props.name: items
props.description: One ring per item, outermost first.

props.name: max
props.description: Value of a full ring. Defaults to the largest value.

props.name: sweep
props.description: Degrees of arc a full ring covers. 270 leaves room for the labels.

props.name: showTotal
props.description: Print the sum of values in the centre.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Print each ring’s label at its start.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the key under the chart.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size in pixels. The chart is square and shrinks with its container.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values in the centre, tooltip and legend.
